description.value: Bimini's is a full-service private liquor store on West 4th Avenue in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, offering a broad selection of beer, wines, and spirits including rotating craft beer taps. The store accepts special occasion orders via its contact form and offers delivery through Uber Eats. Cyclists on the popular West 4th Avenue corridor could stop here for beverage resupply.
